7285365.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Kirkwood
7285365.note: COLlive, 16 Sept 2026 ('New Shluchim to Kirkwood, Missouri'): 'Rabbi Levi and Devora Leah Kesselman and their family have recently moved on shlichus to Kirkwood, Missouri, an inner suburb in the western St. Louis' area; 'The Kesselmans are establishing the first permanent Chabad presence in the community'; appointed by Rabbi Yosef Landa, Regional Director of Chabad of Greater St. Louis. Its chabad.org listing went up 13 Apr 2026.
